name: minimalist-white-studio-swimsuit-grid
image_purpose: swimwear lookbook and model comp sheet

prompt.project_info: Create a clean 3x3 studio contact sheet showing the same adult swimsuit model in standard modeling angles.
prompt.main_subject: One adult fictional female model with original non-celebrity features, hair pulled into a tight bun, wearing a plain white triangle bikini top and high-cut bottoms. Keep poses neutral and non-sexualized with natural proportions and consistent identity.
prompt.composition_elements: Nine tiled panels with thin white borders, centered full-body framing, consistent camera height and distance, front, three-quarter, side, and back variations against a white or cream seamless background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Even soft studio lighting with minimal shadows, clean neutral catalog presentation, crisp realistic fabric and skin texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 3x3 grid in a 3:4 vertical canvas, photorealistic studio photography, consistent scale, alignment, exposure, and color grade, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic studio contact sheet, 3x3 grid of the same adult fictional female model with original non-celebrity features wearing a plain white triangle bikini top and high-cut bottoms, hair in a sleek bun, neutral expression, standing in standard non-sexualized modeling angles across nine tiles: front, three-quarter, side, and back variations. Clean white seamless background, even soft studio lighting, minimal shadows, consistent camera height and distance, centered full-body framing, crisp high-resolution editorial catalog look, thin white borders separating panels.
